pages.text: This is a list of every huge mushroom on Mars, and what climates they grow in.$(br2)Looking for particular type of mushroom stem to decorate your base? This should help you find it. The list is sorted alphabetically by stem type.

pages.title: Aeronos
pages.text: $(bold)Aeronos Mushroom$()$(br)$(thing)Temperature$(): -100°C and above$(br)Appears more often to the East.$(br)$(thing)Growth Days$(): 7

pages.title: Alphacene
pages.text: $(bold)Alphacene Mushroom$()$(br)$(thing)Temperature$(): -85°C and above$(br)Appears both to the East and West.$(br)$(thing)Growth Days$(): 3$(br2)Alphacene Mushroom Blocks can be combined with $(l:mars/mars_crops#bulbkin)Bulbkin Chunks$() to get $(item)Glowstone Dust$().

pages.title: Crimson
pages.text: $(bold)Crimson Mushroom$()$(br)$(thing)Temperature$(): -109 — -13°C$(br)Appears more often to the East.$(br)$(thing)Growth Days$(): 6

pages.title: Glacian
pages.text: $(bold)Glacian Mushroom$()$(br)$(thing)Temperature$(): -107°C and below$(br)Appears both to the East and West.$(br)$(thing)Growth Days$(): 9

pages.title: Strophar
pages.text: $(bold)Strophar Mushroom$()$(br)$(thing)Temperature$(): -100°C and above$(br)Appears more often to the West.$(br)$(thing)Growth Days$(): 7

pages.title: Warped
pages.text: $(bold)Warped Mushroom$()$(br)$(thing)Temperature$(): -109 — -13°C$(br)Appears more often to the West.$(br)$(thing)Growth Days$(): 6

pages.title: Iodine
pages.text: $(l:mars/mars_tree_index#crimson)Crimson$() and $(l:mars/mars_tree_index#warped)Warped$() Mushrooms can be tree tapped for $(4)Crimsene$() and $(3)Warpane$() respectively.$(br2)You'll need both to get started on producing $(thing)Iodine$(), but they don't often grow in the same place, so you might need to travel a bit. You can also obtain the saplings from the corresponding $(l:mars/mars_fauna#endermen)Endermen$().

Mix together the Crimsene and Warpane, along with some Krypton from Mars Air Distillation (it's looped) and the heat from your $(l:mars/fission)Fission Reactor$(), and you'll get $(item)Iodine$()!$(br2)This process is slow, but you shouldn't need a lot of it for now, and there will be better methods of obtaining Iodine on further planets.$(br2)$(bold)Tip:$() Want to show off? You can also build a $(l:logistics/boats#canoe)canoe$() out of Crimson Stems, and build a $(l:logistics/boats#rowboat)Rowboat$() or $(l:logistics/boats#sloop)Sloop$() out of Warped ones!
